2. This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by applicants for quashing the
cognizance and summoning order dated 28.4.2022 and charge sheet dated 24.3.2022 passed in Case

sentences.text: 3.  After some argument, learned counsel for the applicants states that he may be permitted to withdraw this application filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C. with liberty to file bail application before the court below.
4. Learned AGA has no objection to the prayer made by learned counsel for the applicants.
5. Under the circumstances, the present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to applicants to approach the court concerned for bail.
